inj.note: Vera-Tucker suffered a hamstring injury during the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets on Sunday. He was unable to practice during the Patriots' short week, and, in his absence, Walter Rouse likely will take over as the starting left guard for New England. Vera-Tucker's next opportunity to play is Week 8 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Nov. 1.

news.h: Patriots' Alijah Vera-Tucker, Ben Brown ruled out vs. Bears
news.d: The Patriots will be without starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown for Thursday's game against the Bears due to injuries, coach Mike Vrabel said.
